default.shell:
---

{{ if .Vars.win22cis_level_1 }}
  {{ if .Vars.win22cis_rule_1_2_1 }}
command:
  win22cis_1_2_1_lockoutduration:
    title: "1.2.1 | Ensure 'Account lockout duration' is set to '15 or more minute(s)' | LockoutDuration"
    exec: |-
      powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$p = Join-Path '{{ .Vars.win22cis_snapshot_dir }}' 'SystemAccess.LockoutDuration'; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p)) { 'NONCOMPLIANT not_collected' } else { $r = (Get-Content -LiteralPath $p -Raw).Trim(); if ($r -notmatch '^[0-9]+$') { 'NONCOMPLIANT actual=' + $r } else { $v = [int]$r; if ($v -ge {{ .Vars.win22cis_account_lockout_duration }}) { 'COMPLIANT' } else { 'NONCOMPLIANT actual=' + $v } } }"
    exit-status: 0
    stdout:
      - '/^COMPLIANT$/'
    stderr:
      have-len: 0
    timeout: {{ .Vars.timeout_ms }}
    skip: {{ if eq .Vars.win22cis_system_role "standalone" }}false{{ else }}true{{ end }}
    meta:
      skip_reason: "domain scoped - on a domain joined host the Default Domain Policy sets this [System Access] value, so the role does not apply it"
      domaincontroller: 1
      memberserver: 1
      server: 1
      CIS_ID:
        - 1.2.1
      NIST800-53R5:
        - AC-7
        - AC-19
  {{ end }}
{{ end }}

discussion:
Imported from role task file `tasks/section_1/section_1.2.x.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2022-CIS` and Audit control `section_1/section_1.2.x/cis_1.2.1.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2022-CIS-Audit`. The CIS Benchmark text is not part of this source.

No runnable check (when: discovered_win22cis_current_lockout_reset | int > win22cis_account_lockout_duration | int); the original Ansible tasks are the fix.

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "1.2.1 | PATCH | Ensure Account lockout duration is set to 15 or more minutes | Reconcile the reset counter"
  when:
    - win22cis_rule_1_2_1
    - not prelim_win22cis_account_policy_is_domain_scoped
  tags:
    - level1-domaincontroller
    - level1-memberserver
    - rule_1.2.1
    - patch
  block:
    - name: "1.2.1 | AUDIT | Ensure Account lockout duration is set to 15 or more minutes | Read the lockout policy as 1.2.2 left it"
      ansible.windows.win_shell: |
        $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
        # Cmdlets, operators and $Matches only - no .NET method calls - so this still
        # runs where PowerShell is in Constrained Language Mode. secedit must write to
        # a path that does not already exist or the export drops its [Unicode] header.
        $cfg = Join-Path $env:TEMP "cis_lockout_$PID.inf"
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $cfg -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        secedit /export /areas SECURITYPOLICY /cfg $cfg /quiet | Out-Null
        $content = Get-Content -LiteralPath $cfg
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $cfg -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        $duration = 0
        $reset = 0
        foreach ($line in $content) {
          if ($line -match '^LockoutDuration\s*=\s*(\d+)') { $duration = $Matches[1] }
          if ($line -match '^ResetLockoutCount\s*=\s*(\d+)') { $reset = $Matches[1] }
        }
        "$duration $reset"
      changed_when: false
      check_mode: false
      register: discovered_lockout_policy

    - name: "1.2.1 | AUDIT | Ensure Account lockout duration is set to 15 or more minutes | Set the current lockout facts"
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        discovered_win22cis_current_lockout_duration: "{{ discovered_lockout_policy.stdout.split()[0] | int }}"
        discovered_win22cis_current_lockout_reset: "{{ discovered_lockout_policy.stdout.split()[1] | int }}"

    - name: "1.2.1 | PATCH | Ensure Account lockout duration is set to 15 or more minutes | Lower the reset counter so the duration can be applied"
      when:
        - discovered_win22cis_current_lockout_reset | int > win22cis_account_lockout_duration | int
        - win22cis_account_lockout_counter_reset | int <= discovered_win22cis_current_lockout_duration | int
      community.windows.win_security_policy:
        section: System Access
        key: ResetLockoutCount
        value: "{{ win22cis_account_lockout_counter_reset }}"

- name: "1.2.1 | PATCH | Ensure Account lockout duration is set to 15 or more minutes"
  when:
    - win22cis_rule_1_2_1
    - not prelim_win22cis_account_policy_is_domain_scoped
  tags:
    - level1-domaincontroller
    - level1-memberserver
    - rule_1.2.1
    - patch
    - account
    - NIST800-171_3.1.8
    - NIST800-171_3.1.18
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-7
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-19
  block:
    - name: "1.2.1 | PATCH | Ensure Account lockout duration is set to 15 or more minutes | Set Variable"
      when: win22cis_account_lockout_duration >= 15
      community.windows.win_security_policy:
        section: System Access
        key: LockoutDuration
        value: "{{ win22cis_account_lockout_duration }}"

    - name: "1.2.1 | AUDIT | Ensure Account lockout duration is set to 15 or more minutes | Verify variable set to 15 or more minutes warning"
      when: win22cis_account_lockout_duration < 15
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "Warning!! You have an invalid number of minutes set for win22cis_account_lockout_duration please read"
          - "the notes for the variable and make the necessary change to the variable to be in compliance."

    - name: "1.2.1 | AUDIT | Ensure Account lockout duration is set to 15 or more minutes | Set warning count"
      when: win22cis_account_lockout_duration < 15
      vars:
        warn_control_id: '1.2.1'
      ansible.builtin.import_tasks:
        file: warning_facts.yml
